name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.step
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → InPow 2 (w - 1) →
intro l _ X _ _ R w hG hw
have h1 := (UpperTheory.V.Base.lenComp ℤ_[l] X (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) (w - 1)).2
have h2 := cokLen_le_of_range_le (phi l X w hw)
have h3 := cokL l X R hG
calc cokLen (w ^ l - 1) ≤ cokLen (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) + cokLen (w - 1) := h1
show: Let X be generated by R elements over the ℓ-adic integers. If the image of w−1 is contained in ℓ²X, the length of the cokernel of w raised to ℓ minus one is at most the cokernel length of w−1 plus R.
strategy: Factor the difference of powers. The cokernel length of the composition is bounded by the sum of the two cokernel lengths. The geometric-sum factor costs at most R.

steps.claim: The $R$ generators give a surjection $\mathbf Z_\ell^R\to X$. As a quotient of a finitely generated module, $X$ is finitely generated over $\mathbf Z_\ell$.
steps.snippet:
haveI : Module.Finite ℤ_[l] X := by
    obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hG
    exact Module.Finite.of_surjective π hπ

steps.claim: Put $S=\sum_{i<\ell}w^i$. Since $w^\ell-1=S(w-1)$, the length of its cokernel is at most the sum of the two factor cokernel lengths. The hypothesis $(w-1)X\subseteq\ell^2 X$ gives $\ell X\subseteq SX$, hence $\operatorname{length}(X/SX)\le\operatorname{length}(X/\ell X)\le R$. Combining the bounds gives $\operatorname{length}\operatorname{coker}(w^\ell-1)\le\operatorname{length}\operatorname{coker}(w-1)+R$.
steps.snippet:
have h1 := (UpperTheory.V.Base.lenComp ℤ_[l] X (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) (w - 1)).2
  rw [geom_sum_mul] at h1
  have h2 := cokLen_le_of_range_le (phi l X w hw)
  have h3 := cokL l X R hG
  calc cokLen (w ^ l - 1) ≤ cokLen (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) + cokLen (w - 1) := h1
    _ ≤ R + cokLen (w - 1) := add_le_add_left (h2.trans h3) _
    _ = cokLen (w - 1) + R := add_comm _ _

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
